payload.text: For hv: Intent's AGENTS.md generator writes 'swift build' and 'swift test' lines for any project declaring swift. pplr has no Package.swift (its sidecar is built with swiftc), but undeclaring swift would disarm the Swift critic, so the fix is Intent's, out of pplr's scope. dc noted the swiftc caveat in CLAUDE.md's project section (815210a).
